Cycle of Samsara

Enlightened (Nirvana) is able to cycle between three different modes: Normal Mode, Bleed Mode and Hybrid Mode.

  • Normal Mode
  • Bleed Mode
  • Hybrid Mode


Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Staff with a small circle AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with low SPA.


Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Scythe with a large circle AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with 1.5 times longer SPA than Normal Mode. Enlightened (Nirvana) will inflict bleed equal to 30% of his damage over 3 ticks.

In Bleed Mode, he has 13.33% less average DPS than normal mode. However with bleed amplification (x5 bleed dmg), he has 66.66% more average DPS.


Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Halberd with a line AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with 1.5 times more damage, 2 times longer SPA, and 1.5 times more range than Normal Mode. Enlightened (Nirvana) becomes hybrid, gaining the ability to attack flying enemies.

In Hybrid Mode he has 25% less average DPS than normal mode.
